title: Company Identity Resolution
one_line: Resolve a messy company name to the right domain and canonical record, and say how confident the match is.
description: Resolve a messy company name to the right domain and canonical record, and say how confident the match is. Use when a list has company names but no domains, when names are ambiguous, or when enrichment is matching the wrong company.
paragraph: Every enrichment downstream is only as good as the identity it was run on, and company names collide constantly across markets, subsidiaries and rebrands. This skill resolves name to domain with a stated confidence, and refuses a low confidence match rather than guessing, because a wrong match silently poisons every column after it.
keywords: i have company names but no domains
the enrichment matched the wrong company

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: company-identity-resolver 0.007 USD per company.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
